headerDisplay: Exposes your TRV (Trondheim) waste collection plan as one contact sensor per waste fraction. A sensor **opens** on its pickup day between the open and close times. Turn on notifications for the sensors in the Home app to get a reminder.

addressId.title: Address ID
addressId.description: Find your address on https://trv.no/plan/ and copy the UUID from the URL of the plan page.

openTime.title: Open time
openTime.description: When sensors open on pickup day (HH:MM, Norwegian time).

closeTime.title: Close time
closeTime.description: When sensors close again on pickup day (HH:MM, Norwegian time). Must be later than the open time.

exclude.title: Exclude fractions
exclude.description: Fractions that should not get a sensor. Matavfall is usually picked up together with another fraction, so it is a good candidate.
